_comment: Two runs are recorded here on purpose. The first looked perfect and was
misleading; the second is the one we ship and the one we quote. Deleting
the first would remove the evidence for one of the project's central
claims - that an AUC of 1.000 is a warning, not a result.

shipped.status: CURRENT - this is the measurement we quote
shipped.positives: real pilot check-in photographs, trees unseen during setup
shipped.note: Measured against genuinely unseen trees. Provisional: the reference set is still small, and it improves on its own as the system runs, because every verified check-in is another known-good plant photograph.

superseded.status: SUPERSEDED - kept as evidence, do NOT quote this

SAME shoot, so this measured 'was this taken at that shoot', not 'is
this a plant'. Applied to nine real pilot check-ins, the 0.519 threshold
flagged FIVE of them as not-a-plant. The reference images were cropped
